lesson.meaning: To change yourself or something else to fit a new situation or environment successfully.
examples: It took me a few weeks to adapt to the busy city life after moving from a small town.
Our team needs to quickly adapt to the new project management software to avoid delays.
During the meeting, we discussed how to adapt our marketing strategy to reach a younger audience.
A good leader helps their team adapt to unexpected changes and new challenges.
She's very flexible and can easily adapt to different work environments and cultures.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'adapt' as being able to 'adjust' to a new situation, just like a chameleon changes its color to fit its surroundings!
